random_seed_note: Not applicable: training is deterministic and uses no random sampling.
loss_history_note: Not applicable: model parameters are computed in closed form; there is no iterative optimizer.

source_training_file.authoring_provenance: Not included in the source CSV
source_training_file.topic_mapping: Each source article_number was mapped to the corresponding canonical topic in the prepared article catalog; source topic strings are retained in each training row provenance.

calibration.selection_objective: Maximize development top-three hits; among tied settings, choose the highest combined thresholds, then the higher topic threshold and lexical threshold.
calibration.limitation: No out-of-scope development examples were available to estimate false returns.

reproducible_commands: uv run --frozen regulation-finder --data data/real/week3-prepared --model artifacts/training/week3-real-model.json validate
uv run --frozen regulation-finder --data data/real/week3-prepared --model artifacts/training/week3-real-model.json train
uv run --frozen regulation-finder --data data/real/week3-prepared --model artifacts/training/week3-real-model.json calibrate --steps 21 > artifacts/training/week3-development-calibration-grid.json

uv run --frozen regulation-finder --data data/real/week3-prepared --model artifacts/training/week3-real-model.json --min-topic-probability 0.35 --min-lexical-score 0.25 evaluate --split development > artifacts/training/week3-development-evaluation.json
